lines.text: David comes to Nob, where the priest Ahimelech trembles and asks why he is alone, and David asks for five loaves.
Ahimelech has only consecrated bread, and he gives David the Bread of the Presence after David says the young men have kept from women.
Doeg the Edomite, Saul's chief shepherd, is at Nob that day, detained before the LORD.
David asks for a spear or sword, and Ahimelech gives him the sword of Goliath, whom David killed in the Valley of Sorek.
David flees to Achish king of Ashdod, fears him, pretends to be insane, and Achish tells his servants to take him away.
